 What to know as 2027 Medicare open enrollment window nears close 
 By John Redfield Published : Nov. 17, 2026 at 11:21 AM EST | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MARQUETTE, Mich. (WLUC) - You have 20 days left to enroll in Medicare coverage for the 2027 season. 
 On Tuesday’s TV6 Morning News, John Redfield sat down with Kevin Door with Mapping Medicare to learn more about what you should watch out for. 
 “I want to give a reminder to folks. I had two people call me this week, one was a current client and one was not my client, saying that they had been called by someone saying they are from Medicare and they want to review the plan,” Dorr said. “They are breaking the law, so just hang up. It’s a very common thing to be happening now.” 
 Dorr recommends getting in touch with a broker to help navigate you through the open enrollment pro
 You can meet Kevin at Dead River Coffee at 9 a.m. on Wednesday to ask questions and learn more about the services offered to you. You can also connect on the Mapping Medicare Facebook page .
